title: FAFSA Completion Boost Award
description: Scholarships for first-generation students who complete FAFSA by March 1 and enroll in an accredited two- or four-year institution within the region.

title: CommonApp Allied Health Scholars
description: Supports students entering allied health programs (nursing, occupational therapy, radiology) who submit CommonApp application essays focused on community health impact.
eligibility_bullets: CommonApp submission with allied health program listed
Demonstrated volunteer experience in healthcare setting
Letter of recommendation from science or health teacher

title: Faith & Service Ministry Grant
description: Tuition support for seminary students, ministers pursuing continuing education, or dependents of licensed clergy enrolled in undergraduate programs.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant must demonstrate active ministry or clergy household affiliation
Two letters of reference from faith community leaders

title: Buckeye STEM Scholars Equipment Award
description: Funds lab equipment, laptops, or research travel for Ohio students accepted into STEM programs. Priority given to students attending partner universities listed in parameters.
eligibility_bullets: Must be admitted to an Ohio STEM degree program for Fall 2025
Submit proof of acceptance letter and FAFSA confirmation
